worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement between $t=3$ and $t=4.$ Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{3}^{4}(16-9{t}^{2})\,\text{dt} \\  & ={(16t-3{t}^{3})|}_{3}^{4} \\  & =[16(4)-3(4)^{3}]-[16(3)-3(3)^{3}] \\  & =[64-192]-[48-81] \\  & =-95.\end{aligned}
$$
